title: Wood-Fire Artist-in-Residence (1 year, renewable up to 3 years)
source_quote: This is a 1 year position starting in September, with option to to renew up to 3 years.
evidence_sentence: Wood-fire residents participate in and assist with winter and spring anagama firings and several train firings per year, working with director Scott Parady on wood prep and kiln maintenance.
evidence_quote: The Cobb Mountain Art & Ecology Project wood-fire program consist of Winter & Spring Anagama firings and several train firings per year.
summary: Specialized 1-year residency (starting September, renewable to 3 years) for artists with wood-kiln experience, focused on maintaining the anagama and train kiln program; 2026 applications are closed but rolling applications accepted for 2027–2028.
how_to_join: Email a portfolio, letter of intent, CV, artist statement, biography, and three professional references to cobbartandecology@gmail.com with subject line 'Wood-FireA.I.R. 2026 / 2027, Application'.
cost_text: Housing and studio rent $1,200 monthly including utilities; or $950 with 4 hours/week work exchange; or $700 with 8 hours/week work exchange.
commitment: 1 year starting September, renewable up to 3 years total
